mapper.select: select dvt.* from ( SELECT b.* FROM( SELECT a.id, a.api_code, a.local_id, a.sha256_code_list, status, ROW_NUMBER() over ( PARTITION BY sha256_code_list ORDER BY id asc ) AS rn FROM b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_vt a where a.local_id = #{localId} and a.status = 1 order by id asc ) b where b.rn = 1) dvt LEFT JOIN (select id ,sha256_code_list from b_xiecheng_sms_colliding_data_log_vt where send_date =#{sendDate} and local_id = #{localId}) dlvt ON dvt.sha256_code_list = dlvt.sha256_code_list WHERE dvt.rn=1 AND dlvt.id IS NULL order by dvt.id asc limit 10000;
